labels.name: type:epic
labels.description: Parent issue for a module backlog

modules.label: module:dashboard
modules.title: [Dashboard] Consolidate owner dashboard experience
modules.summary: Track the owner-facing dashboard as a delivery epic covering KPIs, quick actions, and shell reliability.

subIssues.title: [Dashboard] Align KPI cards with alerts, inventory, and sales APIs
deliverables: Map every dashboard metric to an explicit API source
Remove any duplicated client-side business rules
Confirm empty-state and error-state handling for each widget
acceptance: Each KPI has a single backend source of truth
Dashboard widgets fail gracefully when upstream data is missing
No metric calculation is duplicated in the frontend

subIssues.title: [Dashboard] Refine quick actions, loading states, and responsive layout
deliverables: Review authenticated shell integration and navigation affordances
Standardize loading placeholders and fallback messages
Validate mobile and desktop layout behavior
acceptance: Dashboard actions navigate to the correct workspaces
Loading and empty states are explicit and consistent
Layout remains usable on common desktop and mobile widths

subIssues.title: [Dashboard] Add regression checklist for owner overview flows
deliverables: Define the critical owner overview scenarios to test manually
Cover alert counts, sales totals, and low-stock surfacing
Document the expected data dependencies for QA
acceptance: A tester can validate the dashboard without reverse engineering the code
Critical overview flows are listed with expected results
Known dependencies are documented for local verification

modules.label: module:auth
modules.title: [Auth] Stabilize authentication and access control
modules.summary: Cover login, refresh, logout, protected routes, and password reset flows.

subIssues.title: [Auth] Harden login, refresh, logout, and password reset API flows
deliverables: Review DTO validation and token lifecycle handling
Verify password reset token expiry, invalidation, and replay protection
Document expected success and failure responses
acceptance: Auth endpoints return normalized responses
Expired or reused reset tokens are rejected explicitly
Token lifecycle behavior is deterministic across login and logout

subIssues.title: [Auth] Review route guards and session handling in the frontend
deliverables: Audit login, register, forgot-password, and reset-password screens
Validate route protection and redirect behavior
Check auth store synchronization with API responses
acceptance: Protected routes redirect consistently for unauthenticated users
Frontend state reflects backend auth truth without drift
Session transitions do not leave stale UI state

subIssues.title: [Auth] Verify shared auth contracts and role semantics
deliverables: Trace auth DTOs and role enums through shared packages and consumers
Remove any contract mismatch between backend and frontend
Confirm role-based restrictions are consistently named
acceptance: Shared auth contracts are the single source of truth
Frontend and backend import compatible role definitions
Role checks are aligned across API and UI

modules.label: module:users
modules.title: [Users] Strengthen user administration and profile management
modules.summary: Track owner-managed user administration and profile editing flows.

subIssues.title: [Users] Review owner user-management API behaviors
deliverables: Validate user creation, activation, and listing workflows
Review authorization boundaries between owner and cashier roles
Confirm response payloads match shared DTOs
acceptance: Only authorized owners can manage store users
User management endpoints expose stable contracts
Role and activation changes are persisted correctly

subIssues.title: [Users] Validate profile workspace and account editing UX
deliverables: Audit user administration and profile workspaces
Check optimistic UI assumptions against backend responses
Review validation, toasts, and submission error handling
acceptance: User and profile screens surface backend validation errors clearly
Edit forms remain synchronized with saved state
Profile-specific flows work without business-logic duplication

subIssues.title: [Users] Add QA coverage for role, activation, and profile scenarios
deliverables: List the key administrative flows and negative cases
Cover role changes, disabled accounts, and profile edits
Define regression checks for owner-only actions
acceptance: Administrative risks are captured in a repeatable checklist
Role and activation regressions are easy to detect
Profile edits have explicit expected outcomes

modules.label: module:categories
modules.title: [Categories] Standardize category lifecycle management
modules.summary: Track catalog category creation, activation, and frontend integration.

subIssues.title: [Categories] Audit category CRUD and activation rules
deliverables: Review create, update, list, and activation logic
Check validation for duplicate or invalid category states
Confirm controller thinness and service-owned rules
acceptance: Category APIs enforce explicit lifecycle rules
Duplicate or invalid category states are handled safely
Business logic remains inside the service layer

subIssues.title: [Categories] Verify category workspace integration with product and POS flows
deliverables: Check category creation and activation UX
Trace how categories feed product creation and cashier filtering
Review empty-state and disabled-state behavior
acceptance: Category updates propagate correctly to dependent UI flows
Frontend uses backend-provided category truth
Category states are visible and understandable to operators

subIssues.title: [Categories] Validate shared category contracts and regression cases
deliverables: Confirm DTO alignment between modules and UI consumers
List regression cases for inactive or missing categories
Document any contract edge cases relevant to downstream modules
acceptance: Shared contracts prevent duplicate category typing
Inactive-category regressions are explicitly tracked
Downstream consumers know how category edge cases are handled

modules.label: module:products
modules.title: [Products] Harden product catalog management
modules.summary: Track product CRUD, media, pricing, category mapping, and catalog integrity.

subIssues.title: [Products] Audit product CRUD, barcode uniqueness, and threshold rules
deliverables: Review DTO validation, pricing fields, and product lifecycle rules
Verify barcode uniqueness and category linkage behavior
Confirm stock-threshold handling stays in the service layer
acceptance: Product endpoints enforce explicit catalog constraints
Barcodes remain unique and validated
Threshold and catalog rules are not split across layers

subIssues.title: [Products] Review product workspace, forms, and media flows
deliverables: Audit create and edit forms, previews, and validation messaging
Check image handling and category selection UX
Validate inventory-related product fields on the client
acceptance: Product forms reflect backend validation accurately
Media and category selection flows behave consistently
Frontend does not recreate product business rules

subIssues.title: [Products] Align shared product contracts with downstream consumers
deliverables: Trace product DTO usage in inventory, POS, and reports
Eliminate mismatched product shape assumptions
Document contract dependencies for future module work
acceptance: Product types are shared rather than duplicated
Downstream modules consume a consistent product contract
Schema changes have a clear impact map

modules.label: module:inventory
modules.title: [Inventory] Secure stock supervision and movement workflows
modules.summary: Track stock visibility, threshold monitoring, expiry handling, and movement updates.

subIssues.title: [Inventory] Review stock update rules, threshold evaluation, and expiry handling
deliverables: Audit inventory service logic for stock movement updates
Check low-stock, out-of-stock, and expiry derivation behavior
Inspect query efficiency and avoid N+1 style regressions
acceptance: Inventory updates preserve consistent stock state
Alert-driving conditions are derived predictably
Inventory queries remain operationally efficient

subIssues.title: [Inventory] Validate inventory workspace filters, tables, and action flows
deliverables: Review stock list, search, filters, and warning surfacing
Check editing or adjustment entry points against backend capabilities
Verify empty states and operator clarity
acceptance: Critical stock states are visible without ambiguity
Frontend actions map directly to supported backend behavior
Filtering and search behave consistently across datasets

subIssues.title: [Inventory] Define regression checks for stock integrity and expiry scenarios
deliverables: List stock increase, decrease, threshold, and expiry test scenarios
Cover edge cases such as zero stock and missing expiration dates
Document validation expectations for manual QA
acceptance: Inventory edge cases have explicit regression coverage
Manual QA can confirm stock integrity outcomes quickly
Expiry-related behavior is documented end to end

modules.label: module:sales
modules.title: [Sales] Stabilize POS checkout and sales history flows
modules.summary: Track cashier checkout, payment capture, receipt generation, and sales history behavior.

subIssues.title: [Sales] Audit checkout API, line totals, and receipt data integrity
deliverables: Review cart submission, totals, and payment-mode handling
Validate sale item line-total persistence and response shape
Confirm inventory side effects remain consistent after checkout
acceptance: Checkout persists correct totals and sale items
Receipt data is complete enough for frontend printing
Sales writes do not corrupt inventory state

subIssues.title: [Sales] Review POS workspace, receipt screen, and sales history UX
deliverables: Audit cashier product selection, cart, and payment workflows
Check receipt navigation and printing integration
Review sales-history filters, loading states, and error handling
acceptance: Cashier flows are fast and operationally clear
Receipts are accessible from the checkout flow
Sales-history UI matches the available backend data

subIssues.title: [Sales] Validate shared sales contracts across POS, receipts, and reports
deliverables: Trace sale DTOs into receipt and reporting consumers
Eliminate duplicated total or line-item assumptions
Document contract dependencies for checkout-related modules
acceptance: Sales contract changes are visible to dependent modules
Receipt and reporting consumers share the same sale model
Frontend total calculations do not drift from backend truth

modules.label: module:alerts
modules.title: [Alerts] Strengthen operational alerting and follow-up
modules.summary: Track alert derivation, read-state handling, dropdown behavior, and operational follow-up flows.

subIssues.title: [Alerts] Review low-stock and expiry alert generation rules
deliverables: Audit alert derivation from inventory state
Check alert read-state persistence and retrieval behavior
Confirm alert service abstractions remain modular
acceptance: Alert generation reflects real inventory conditions
Read-state changes persist correctly
Alert logic is isolated within the alerts module

subIssues.title: [Alerts] Validate alerts workspace and dropdown interaction design
deliverables: Review alerts page, dropdown, and provider state handling
Check unread counts, loading states, and action affordances
Validate cross-navigation from alerts into relevant workspaces
acceptance: Operators can identify and clear alerts with minimal friction
Unread counts remain synchronized with backend state
Alerts UI avoids hidden or stale state

subIssues.title: [Alerts] Trace email-notification dependencies and escalation behavior
deliverables: Map how alerts trigger optional email notifications
Define the operational fallback when SMTP is unavailable
Document the risk boundaries between in-app and email alerts
acceptance: Email escalation behavior is explicit and testable
Alerting remains usable without SMTP delivery
Operational dependencies are documented for maintainers

modules.label: module:reports
modules.title: [Reports] Standardize reporting and export reliability
modules.summary: Track KPI reporting, date-window logic, export behavior, and analytics presentation.

subIssues.title: [Reports] Audit reporting aggregation logic and date-window handling
deliverables: Review revenue, basket, transaction, and stock-summary calculations
Check timezone and period-filter semantics
Inspect reporting queries for correctness and efficiency
acceptance: Reporting calculations match intended business definitions
Date windows behave consistently across environments
Query patterns remain acceptable for operational use

subIssues.title: [Reports] Validate charts, tables, and CSV export workflows
deliverables: Audit reporting workspace charts and detailed tables
Check export UX and downloaded dataset expectations
Review loading, empty-state, and no-data behavior
acceptance: Operators can trust the displayed and exported report data
Charts and tables represent the same underlying metrics
No-data states are explicit rather than confusing

subIssues.title: [Reports] Align report DTOs with dashboard and sales consumers
deliverables: Trace report contracts into dashboard summary widgets
Eliminate duplicate assumptions about metric names or shapes
Document reporting contract dependencies
acceptance: Reporting types are shared where cross-module reuse exists
Dashboard and reports do not drift on metric semantics
Future metric changes have a documented impact path

modules.label: module:health
modules.title: [Health] Improve service health and readiness tracking
modules.summary: Track readiness checks and operational verification for runtime dependencies.

subIssues.title: [Health] Verify backend health endpoints for critical dependencies
deliverables: Review current health controller coverage
Check whether database, mail, and runtime dependencies are represented appropriately
Document intended health semantics for local and deployed environments
acceptance: Health endpoints have clear operational meaning
Critical dependencies are covered intentionally
Status responses are understandable to operators

subIssues.title: [Health] Align Docker and runtime checks with health expectations
deliverables: Trace compose health checks and startup ordering expectations
Identify gaps between application readiness and container health
Document the minimum verification flow for developers
acceptance: Container health semantics do not misrepresent app readiness
Local startup checks are reproducible
Operational verification steps are explicit

subIssues.title: [Health] Add regression checklist for startup and dependency failures
deliverables: List expected outcomes for dependency-up and dependency-down scenarios
Cover database and mail-related startup behavior
Capture the observable signals a maintainer should verify
acceptance: Startup regressions can be detected quickly
Failure scenarios are documented with expected symptoms
Maintainers know what to validate after infrastructure changes

modules.label: module:mail
modules.title: [Mail] Secure SMTP delivery and notification reliability
modules.summary: Track the shared mail module used by password reset and alert notifications.

subIssues.title: [Mail] Audit SMTP configuration validation and send-path behavior
deliverables: Review mail service usage and configuration safeguards
Check startup behavior when SMTP variables are missing or partial
Confirm explicit failure handling for delivery attempts
acceptance: Mail behavior is explicit under valid and invalid configuration
Partial SMTP configuration does not fail silently
Delivery failures are observable and actionable

subIssues.title: [Mail] Validate integration with auth reset and alert-notification flows
deliverables: Trace mail dependencies from auth and alerts modules
Check message-triggering conditions and recipient targeting
Document module boundaries around mail responsibilities
acceptance: Mail is invoked intentionally from dependent modules
Recipient and trigger rules are understandable
Cross-module boundaries remain clear

subIssues.title: [Mail] Define delivery verification and fallback operations
deliverables: Describe the checks needed to validate SMTP in local and hosted environments
Record the fallback product behavior when email is unavailable
Add a maintainer checklist for operational troubleshooting
acceptance: SMTP verification steps are documented clearly
The product remains understandable when email is unavailable
Maintainers have a repeatable troubleshooting flow

modules.label: module:platform
modules.title: [Platform] Keep shared contracts, database, and delivery workflow aligned
modules.summary: Track shared packages, Prisma schema, seed data, and developer workflow consistency.

subIssues.title: [Platform] Synchronize shared packages with backend and frontend consumers
deliverables: Review shared-types and shared-utils usage across the monorepo
Identify duplicated contract definitions or helper logic
Document any consumer coupling that needs to stay synchronized
acceptance: Shared packages remain the contract source of truth

Cross-package dependencies are visible to maintainers

subIssues.title: [Platform] Review Prisma schema, migrations, and seed coherence
deliverables: Audit schema-to-module alignment for current business flows
Check recent migrations for consistency with runtime logic
Verify seed data still supports key operator workflows

Seed data remains useful for manual validation

deliverables: Review root scripts and workspace verification flow
Check Docker Compose expectations against the documented setup
Document the minimum delivery checklist for contributors
